title: Temporal domain and invariants
summary: A TimeInstant denotes an instant on the declared POSIX seconds timescale; civil readings are local calendar values, not necessarily a unique instant. A TimeZoneRules provider maps an instant to civil labels and resolves UNIQUE, GAP or FOLD candidates. Duration in elapsed seconds is distinct from an institutional calendar period or civil recurrence.
invariants: Never turn a civil reading into UTC without explicit zone and rules.
Report gap and fold; never silently select an instant.
'Now' requires a declared clock source and must not be inferred from the transport.
